info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Status API provides access to the current status of student enrollments in educational programs. By leveraging this endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive details on enrollment statuses, helping institutions manage and monitor student participation effectively. Typical consumers of this API include educational institutions, administrators, and data analysts who require real-time information for reporting and decision-making purposes. This API supports enhanced visibility into enrollment trends and assists in strategic planning.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of enrollments. It provides insights into whether the enrollments are active, pending, or completed, helping you manage the enrollment process effectively.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the current status of the enrollments. This request body is expected to provide information necessary for determining the enrollment status.

200.description: Indicates that the request was successful and returns the current enrollment status.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body as a string for the GET operation related to enrollments status.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.title: Enrollment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the enrollment status is successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the enrollment request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the enrollment operation.

state.description: Current state of the enrollment process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the enrollment request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the enrollment status.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the enrollment operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.description: Represents the response for the enrollment status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains metadata about the audit of an operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request.
